utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still gathering donations for the repair drive. I can tell you which houses on our block already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Which houses signed up, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I saw the Martinez place and the Lee house on our block signed up already. I can check whether anyone else nearby did too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by for the repair drive and let Noah know we’ve got it lined up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, thanks for lining it up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep Noah posted and swing by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10 a.m. over by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The wiring in the shed light and the front latch are giving us trouble. If you’ve got a screwdriver, that’s the first thing to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring a screwdriver and take a look at the shed light first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need the repair drive details first. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking Saturday around 10 a.m. I’ll send the full repair drive details over so you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me. Send the details when you can, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive. What’s first on the list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: First, we’ll list the jobs by what’s broken most and what we can fix fastest. I’d start with the urgent safety stuff, then the easy repairs, and keep the bigger jobs for after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive is happening? Count me in, Pia - I'll spread the word and make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’m on it. I’ll keep passing the word around so everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but I’m still piecing together the details. Is it the one for the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good, I think so, but I only heard it second-hand too. Rosa said it’s for the community hall and a few nearby houses.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what part of the repair drive needs attention? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The north wall by the back door is the part that needs attention. If you can help there, that would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I can help with that north wall by the back door.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I’ll need to take it slow.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, that works for me. I’ll join in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Appreciate it. I’ll be there when I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools ready if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of tools did you bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I brought a hammer, a screwdriver set, a wrench, and some tape. If you need anything else, I can check my shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can track where the repair drive is if you tell me the address or last stop. I don't have it noted yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the address on hand, but I think the last stop was the corner by Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps. I’ll check the corner by Maple and 3rd first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools you can borrow for the repair drive if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I run short.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Rey. Just let me know what you need and I’ll bring the right tools over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the pickup window and who’s handling the drop-offs. Otherwise the repair drive could turn into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup window and who’s doing the drop-offs?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I still need the exact pickup window and the drop-off person before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help get folks sorted out for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I need someone to coordinate sign-ups and a simple checklist for each repair request.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take sign-ups and make a simple checklist for each repair request. I’ll keep it easy to fill out and share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare gloves and a roll of tape I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’ll be there a bit later and can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set the tape and gloves aside for you. See you later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some real traction now. Folks are pitching in, so maybe your side of town will see fixes sooner than expected.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I’m hearing too—sounds like the next round of fixes could come faster if the momentum keeps up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll get the repair drive organized and send around the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. Just send me the details when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive, Leo. Just tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. I just need the cable and the loose hinge fixed, then I’m set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll take care of the cable and the loose hinge.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive’s happening? I’ll spread the word and make sure Nell knows she’s welcome to join us.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. I’ll keep an ear out and see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll let you know if anything changes before then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that. Where should I bring the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bring it by the front porch after lunch. I’ll be home then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll bring it by the front porch after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Repair drive? How do I sign up, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You can sign up with me here, and I’ll need your name, the best way to reach you, and whether you want morning or afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m available in the morning, and you can reach me by phone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving ahead. Need me to keep an eye out for anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — if you hear about any parts or tools they still need, let me know and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do. I’ll keep an ear out for any parts or tools they’re short on.
